title: 购物人数少400万：假日销售额却破万亿，钱到底花哪了
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Shoppers here in Midtown, Manhattan, stay there ready to open their wallets and expand this holiday season even though a lot of items cost more compared to 2025.
segments.zh: 曼哈顿中城的购物者已准备好打开钱包，在这个假日季增加支出，尽管许多商品相比2025年价格更高。

segments.en: The big difference, though, is that many say they plan to shop a bit more hesitantly thinking twice before they buy.
segments.zh: 但最大的不同在于，许多人表示他们计划购物时会更犹豫，购买前会三思。

segments.en: Black Friday, the traditional start of the holiday shopping season, the National Retail Federation expects 182.7 million people to shop this Thanksgiving weekend,
segments.zh: 黑色星期五是传统假日购物季的开始，全美零售联合会预计今年感恩节周末将有1.827亿人购物，

segments.en: approximately 4 million fewer than last year.
However, total sales in November and December are projected to surpass $1 trillion.
segments.zh: 然而，11月和12月的总销售额预计将超过1万亿美元。

segments.en: While it's the season for giving, experts say more shoppers are splurging on themselves.
segments.zh: 虽然这是送礼的季节，但专家表示更多购物者在自己身上挥霍。

segments.en: Self-gifting is a real thing and when you look at the data you actually see that almost half the budget is on things for myself versus things for others.
segments.zh: 自我赠礼是真实存在的，当你查看数据时，你会发现几乎一半的预算花在自己身上，而不是给别人买东西。

segments.en: So that's a really interesting statistic. According to the Bureau of Economic Analysis, after strong gains early this year, US consumers spending stalled in October.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常有趣的统计数据。根据经济分析局的数据，在今年年初强劲增长后，美国消费者支出在10月停滞。

segments.en: This as consumers continue to pay more for housing and groceries, but a steady labor market is providing some support.
segments.zh: 这是因为消费者继续为住房和食品杂货支付更多，但稳定的劳动力市场提供了一些支持。

segments.en: The latest jobs report puts unemployment at just 4.1%, this year's stock market gains, also giving consumers a lift online.
segments.zh: 最新就业报告显示失业率仅为4.1%，今年权益资产上涨也为线上消费者带来提振。
